entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hi, you're speaking with David from VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hello David. I'm calling about the VeloBand GPS Tracker I bought a couple of weeks ago. I think I'd like to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, the name is Anya Sharma, and the order number is VF781109.
Thank you, Anya. I see your order here, delivered on December 15th, so about 17 days ago. May I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's more of a preference issue. I just find the whole interface to be very confusing. It's surprisingly hard to use, and I really expected more functionality for the price.
I understand. Did you get a chance to look at the quick-start guide in the user manual? Sometimes that can clarify the main functions.

I did. I read the user manual, but it still feels clumsy. I know I'm past the 14-day mark that most companies use. I'm not looking to cause trouble, but is there any possibility of a partial store credit or maybe a discount on a future purchase if I keep it?
I appreciate you explaining that. Let me just check our official return policy for you. One moment.
Thank you.
Okay, I've just pulled up our policy information. It looks like our standard return window is actually 90 days from the date of delivery.
Oh, really? Ninety days?
Yes, that's correct. Since you're only on day 17, you are well within the timeframe for a full refund. There's no need for a partial credit; I can process a full return for you right now.
Wow, that's fantastic. I was completely prepared to negotiate. Yes, please, let's go ahead with the full refund. That's a great policy to have.

Of course. I've just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file. Simply pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at the post office. Your refund will be processed 3-5 business days after we receive the item.
That's perfect. Thank you so much for making that so easy, David.
You're very welcome, Anya. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again!
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
